title: nf-core/easi pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for RNA-seq samples. Samples can be supplied as FASTQs or as previously processed BAM and Salmon outputs.

sample.description: Unique identifier for an individual RNA-seq sample or library.
sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain whitespace.

condition.description: Experimental condition or group to which the sample belongs.
condition.errorMessage: Condition must be provided and cannot contain whitespace.

replicate.description: Replicate identifier within the experimental condition.
replicate.errorMessage: Replicate must be a positive integer.

donor.description: Optional biological donor or patient identifier.
donor.errorMessage: Donor must be a nonempty identifier without whitespace when provided.

batch.description: Optional experimental or sequencing batch identifier.
batch.errorMessage: Batch must be a nonempty identifier without whitespace when provided.

strandedness.description: Library strandedness. Use 'auto' to infer strandedness from the aligned reads, or specify forward, reverse or unstranded.
strandedness.errorMessage: Strandedness must be one of: auto, forward, reverse, unstranded.

single_end.description: Optional sequencing layout. true = single-end; false = paired-end. Automatically determined when FASTQs are supplied. Required when reusing BAM and Salmon outputs without FASTQs.

fastq_1.description: Optional FASTQ read 1. Required when reusable BAM and Salmon outputs are not both supplied.
fastq_1.errorMessage: FASTQ read 1 must exist and have the extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'.

fastq_2.description: Optional FASTQ read 2 for paired-end sequencing.
fastq_2.errorMessage: FASTQ read 2 must exist and have the extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'.

bam.description: Optional previously aligned, coordinate-sorted BAM file. Must have been generated using a compatible reference genome and alignment settings.
bam.errorMessage: BAM file must exist and have the extension '.bam'.

bai.description: BAM index corresponding to the supplied BAM file.
bai.errorMessage: BAM index must exist and have the extension '.bai'.

salmon_quant.description: Optional directory containing previously generated Salmon quantification outputs, including quant.sf. Must be compatible with the transcriptome reference and quantification settings used by EASI.
salmon_quant.errorMessage: Salmon quantification directory must exist and cannot contain whitespace.
